name: API Securist
description: Collects HTTP traffic for identifying security issues.

data_collection_permissions.justification: API Securist captures HTTP requests and responses, including URLs, headers, and body data, from the user's active browser tab for security testing and API analysis. The captured data may include website content and browsing activity. Data is only transmitted to the user's selected cloud endpoint (https://ApiSecurist.cloud) when the user explicitly initiates an upload. No personal identity, authentication, or background analytics are collected.
